notes: Nine distinct manipulation episodes are visible. Opening/removal is treated as the on transition and closing/replacement as the off transition.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a kitchen and adjacent living area. The user sequentially opens and closes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets, then manipulates lids on two countertop cookers and the drawer of an air fryer.
